indicator_name: Mean monthly money income per capita by decile, annual
description: Среднемесячный денежный доход на душу населения по децильным группам, годовой
methodology: Mean of each decile, from the annual editions (2022 onward; Taldau has the levels only for the bottom and top decile). 2025: 44 360 (D01) to 265 626 (D10). Editions read: 37365 2022, 179025 2023, 341348 2024, 341349 2025.
